item.tarkovscav.he_grenade.tooltip: A big blast and few fragments. Fuse 4 s

item.tarkovscav.flash_grenade.tooltip: Long fuse (2 s). Facing it: about 5 s of white-out; looking away halves it
item.tarkovscav.flash_grenade_short.tool: Goes off on impact (0.4 s); roughly half the blind time
item.tarkovscav.grenade.charge: Hold right-click to charge the throw (further the longer you hold; the fuse burns while you do)

item.tarkovscav.deployment_beacon.toolti: Opens a way into the urban wasteland. Use it in the overworld to deploy, or inside the wasteland to come back.
Right-click to deploy: a %s s cast, broken by damage or by moving more than 4 blocks; %s s cooldown. The beacon itself is never consumed.
tarkovscav.beacon.cast.start: Deploying in %s s - do not move more than %s blocks.
tarkovscav.beacon.cast.moved: Deployment broken: you moved too far.
tarkovscav.beacon.arrived.platform: Nothing to stand on there - an arrival platform was built under you.
tarkovscav.beacon.return.fallback: No deployment on record: returning you to the overworld's shared spawn at %s.
tarkovscav.beacon.refused.player: Only a player can deploy: a command block or the console has no body to move.
tarkovscav.beacon.refused.dimension: The deployment beacon only works in the overworld (to deploy) or in %s (to return); %s is neither.
tarkovscav.beacon.refused.cooldown: The deployment beacon is still recharging (%s s).
tarkovscav.beacon.refused.missing: This server has no tarkovscav:urban_wasteland dimension loaded, so the beacon has nowhere to send you.
tarkovscav.command.dimension.fallback: No stored overworld position for you - used the overworld's shared spawn instead.
tarkovscav.command.dimension.unknown: This server has no dimension '%s'. Use a loaded dimension id, for example tarkovscav:urban_wasteland.
item.tarkovscav.village_command_tool.too: Commands the VILLAGE faction and nothing else.
item.tarkovscav.illager_command_tool.too: Commands the ILLAGER faction and nothing else.
item.tarkovscav.scav_command_tool.toolti: Commands the SCAV faction and nothing else.
item.tarkovscav.command_tool.tooltip: Command tool: %s faction only - it can never order another line-up.
item.tarkovscav.command_tool.tooltip2: Affects units matching the tag %s within command.radius blocks of the mark.
item.tarkovscav.command_tool.tooltip3: Right-click a block: new mark + advance. Sneak+right-click a block: mark only. Right-click air: advance on the current mark. Sneak+right-click air: cycle marks.
item.tarkovscav.signal_stick.tooltip: Thrown tool: lands and plants a command mark. It drops itself, so you can pick it back up.
item.tarkovscav.signal_stick.tooltip2: The mark lives %s s and then disappears on its own.
item.tarkovscav.signal_point.tooltip: Places a PERMANENT command mark. Breaking the block retracts its mark.
tarkovscav.command.disabled: The command system is switched off (command.enabled = false).
tarkovscav.command.no.marks: There are no marks in this dimension yet - right-click a block with a command tool, throw a signal stick, or place a signal point.
tarkovscav.command.no.units: No %s units within %s blocks of that mark (only this mod's own armed units can be ordered).
tarkovscav.command.mark.created: Mark %s created. It is now your current mark; sneak+right-click air to cycle.
tarkovscav.command.point.placed: Permanent signal point %s placed. Break the block to retract it.
